description: Set or replace the custom domain for your GrowSurf program's landing pages. Pass a hostname such as `refer.example.com` in `domain`; `https://` is added if you leave it out. Paths, ports, queries, and `http://` return `400`. Replacing a domain removes the old one right away, and its pages stop loading there, so confirm with the customer before replacing a domain that is already set. Sending the current domain again changes nothing. A domain used by another program returns `409`, and `403` means the account cannot use custom domains yet: a higher plan is needed, or for an affiliate program, a payment method on file. A new domain starts unverified: add the `CNAME` record from the returned `dnsRecord` at the DNS provider (`dnsRecord.name` pointing to `dnsRecord.value`), then call `growsurf_verify_campaign_custom_domain`. Targets `campaignId` if supplied, otherwise `GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID`.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Program IDs also identify newly created programs without restarting the server.

domain.description: The hostname to serve the program's landing pages from, with or without `https://`, such as `refer.example.com`.

name: growsurf_set_campaign_custom_domain

outputSchema.description: The custom domain after the change. Same shape as the `growsurf_get_campaign_custom_domain` result.

title: Set Program Custom Domain
